thread:
katie: FYI opened docs PR for the coming release: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345 — includes model-catalog changelog, deprecation note for `rw-embed-v1`, and an SDK snippet migration section. Need 2 reviewers + green CI. Target merge before Fri 09:00 PT so release notes can be cut.
ravi: taking a look now. quick q — did you update the migration snippet for the new embeddings param name? we changed `vector_dim` -> `dimension` in the SDK last month.
katie: yes, there's a small note and a code example at the bottom. current snippet:
```
from redwood import EmbeddingsClient
client = EmbeddingsClient()
client.create(input=["hello"], dimension=1536)
```
laura: I can review docs style and the wording on the deprecation paragraph. Will check links and the catalog table.
sam: tagging release-ops @release-ops — we'll need the final changelog copy by EOD Thu to include in the release email. Any merge freeze windows to be aware of?
release-ops: merge freeze starts Fri 08:00 PT, so we need merges by 07:30 PT. Also flagging: if there are model-catalog schema changes we need to run the data migration job — doc PR mentions a new `compatibility` column. Confirmed?
katie: yes, added `compatibility` column note with migration steps and the SQL snippet. It's non-destructive but requires small post-deploy migration job. Snippet:
```
ALTER TABLE model_catalog ADD COLUMN compatibility varchar(32) DEFAULT 'compatible';
UPDATE model_catalog SET compatibility='limited' WHERE model_name LIKE '%-quant%';
```
max: CI preview failed on the initial run — docs-ci-bot posted a 404 for the model-ids table link. I pushed a fix to the link in the table, retrying preview.
docs-ci-bot: Netlify preview: https://deploy-preview-2345--docs.redwood.ai/ (status: building)
laura: saw a couple of wording nits in the deprecation paragraph — suggested shorter sentence about timeline and link to migration guide. Pushed a small commit.
ravi: left inline suggestion to clarify the SDK example about `dimension` default. Also pointed out we should add a small compatibility note for Dedicated customers (they might need a model pin).
katie: good catch — added a short note under 'Deployment considerations' and pinged platform to confirm rollout behavior.
max: Netlify preview is green: https://deploy-preview-2345--docs.redwood.ai/ (status: success) — screenshots attached in the PR checks.
laura: approved — style LGTM. left one nit about punctuation.
ravi: approved after my tiny tweak to the example doc string.
sam: approved for content. @katie please confirm release-ops got the final changelog block for the release email.
katie: copied final changelog block to /releases/changelog-draft.md and pinged release-ops. Ready to merge once CI stays green and no last-minute regressions.
release-ops: received changelog block. We'll wait for 30m for any late feedback, then cut the release notes and tag the release branch. If you can merge by 07:00 PT that gives us margin.
katie: merging now. command: `gh pr merge 2345 --squash --delete-branch` (will watch CI). :crossed_fingers:
docs-ci-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #2345 — merging enabled.
katie: merged. thanks everyone! I will follow up with a short post in #release-war-room once notes are published.
release-ops: thanks — noted in the release checklist. :tada:
max: quick follow-up: updated internal snippet in SDK docs to include a short note about rate limits and batching, so migration guide covers performance implications.
laura: great, closing thread. If anything pops up during release prep, reopen a thread in #release-war-room. :)
